cv.title: Junior Economist | Economic Research and Data Analysis
cv.profile_paragraph: Economist with a strong quantitative and data-focused profile, combining applied econometrics, data structuring and policy-oriented analysis. Experience in cleaning, documenting and analyzing multi-source datasets, producing clear syntheses and supporting evidence-based decision-making. Comfortable working with statistical tools, spreadsheets and structured reporting in collaborative environments.

cover_letter.subject: Application for Global Research - Junior Economist - Analyst or Associate
paragraphs: I am applying for the Global Research - Junior Economist - Analyst or Associate position within JPMorgan Chase's Economic Research Team. My background in economics combines applied econometrics, data structuring and policy-oriented analysis, with experience in turning complex datasets into clear and usable outputs.

Through academic work and project experience, I have developed a strong quantitative approach to economic questions. I have worked on data cleaning, schema normalization, quality checks and analytical documentation, and I have used statistical tools and Python-based workflows to prepare reliable datasets for analysis. This has strengthened my attention to detail, my organization and my ability to synthesize information clearly.

I am particularly interested in the opportunity to support senior economists with data gathering, statistical analysis, monitoring of data releases and contributions to reports and presentations. The role's emphasis on rigorous analysis, structured writing and collaboration in an international environment is closely aligned with my profile and working style.
I would welcome the opportunity to contribute my analytical skills, economic training and commitment to high-quality work to JPMorgan Chase's Economic Research Team.
